This is a single small (4,289 byte) specification document, not code: the addendum
`test_the_sdk_still_has_no_regression_label_so_the_fifth_rule_stays_out` quotes from, to check
that the SDK's own spec still refuses to characterise a diff as a regression — the condition
put on ever building `I-DIFF-REGRESSION`.

**Why it is committed rather than read live.** It lives under `spec/` in the private
`onetrace-sdk-bootstrap` repository, which is deliberately **excluded from the public export**
— it is not in the sdist `tools/fetch_sdk_fixtures.py` downloads, and was never
reachable any other way once the `.pins/onetrace` clone this test used to read it from was
removed. There is no public source to fetch this from; a frozen copy is the only option left that
does not reintroduce a private-repository dependency.

**Provenance, checked rather than assumed.** The git blob is `388b4f4326cab560787e2224055d39c106066919`
at `onetrace-sdk-bootstrap` commit `4c11f0e1254d5e75f51ee165fb28080ae0b276a5` (this console's
earlier pin) — confirmed identical (same blob) at `b63eb86` (the later pin), so the
document has not moved between the two.

**Two changes from that blob, made here.** Line 7 named the person whose scenario the addendum
answers; it now reads "Triggered by a scenario". Line 61 named the machine a comparison ran on;
it now reads "the test machine". Nothing the test quotes is on either line, and no other byte
differs. `SHA256SUMS` records the edited copy.

`SHA256SUMS` (this directory) is generated by `tools/hash_fixture.py`, never hand-typed.
